method: Average reprojection to 1800×1502 Web Mercator pixels; generalized land mask from existing Natural Earth country outlines. Terrain class colours plus conventional shaded relief in five intensity levels. 500 m contours computed from this display grid, not from full-resolution DEM. Lookup rounded to whole metres (not metre accuracy). Rivers/lakes are Natural Earth 1:50m v5.1.2; line thickness is not discharge.
